page_title: SOU 1-0 EVE | Southampton v Everton 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' The foul by Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Andy Madley.
90+3' Russell Martin prepares a substitution. Mateus Fernandes is replaced by Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton).
90+3' The referee signals a substitution. Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is brought on as a substitute for Cameron Archer.
90+2' The goal by Everton won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90+1' The Everton players halt their celebrations as referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Beto (Everton) shoots and it's a goal!
88' A substitution has been made. Jesper Lindstrom is replaced by Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton).
88' Rough tackle by Adam Armstrong (Southampton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Everton get a free kick.
85' 1 - 0 Adam Armstrong (Southampton) collects a sweet pass inside the penalty box and smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish!

85' It looks like Tyler Dibling (Southampton) saw red with that tackle. Andy Madley won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Everton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
84' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) has received a yellow card for his foul.
82' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
79' Russell Martin decides to make a substitution. Jack Stephens will be replaced by Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton).
79' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

78' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save. Good work from Everton as they win a corner.
76' A yellow card for a tackle by Jan Bednarek (Southampton). Andy Madley doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
76' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
73' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
70' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

68' Michael Keane (Everton) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom right corner. Aaron Ramsdale shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
68' The resulting corner from Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

66' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Dwight McNeil (Everton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Everton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' A player from Southampton commits a rough challenge. Andy Madley blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. There is a free kick near the sideline to Everton.
64' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
62' Sean Dyche has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jack Harrison (Everton) replacing Iliman Ndiaye.
62' Substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin will be replaced by Beto (Everton).

62' Joe Aribo (Southampton) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
60' A cross from a corner kick by Everton is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
59' Here is a change. Ryan Manning is going off and Russell Martin gives the last tactical orders to Tyler Dibling (Southampton).
59' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Southampton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Corner kick. Southampton will have an opportunity.
56' Today's referee Andy Madley rightly decides to book Michael Keane (Everton) for his harsh tackle.
55' Ryan Manning (Southampton) brings an opponent down and Andy Madley interrupts the game. Free kick. Everton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
52' A player from Everton commits a rough challenge. Andy Madley blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
52' Everton fail to score from a corner as Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) leaps to collect the ball.

51' A neat pass is well received by Orel Mangala (Everton), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. Everton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
51' Good movement by Jesper Lindstrom (Everton), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
46' Half-time substitution. Adam Lallana will not participate anymore and Joe Aribo (Southampton) is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
45+1' The ball goes out of play. Southampton are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Half-chance! Adam Armstrong (Southampton) plays a pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford reacts well to snuff out the attack.
41' Cameron Archer (Southampton) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
40' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Southampton will take a free kick.
39' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

39' Ryan Manning (Southampton) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Everton, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
38' The corner is swung in but Everton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
34' Ashley Young (Everton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Southampton have been awarded a free kick.
33' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
32' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
32' The resulting set piece from Southampton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Ryan Manning (Southampton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Southampton will take a corner kick.
31' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Everton is cautioned for aggressive play. It's a free kick to Southampton, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
29' A player from Everton commits a rough challenge. Andy Madley blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Southampton are awarded a free kick.
26' Ryan Manning (Southampton) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
24' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to James Tarkowski (Everton) for a tough tackle.
23' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
23' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) takes a short corner kick.

23' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

21' Flynn Downes (Southampton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Andy Madley with no other option than to blow for a foul. Everton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
20' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Cameron Archer (Southampton) heads on.
19' James Tarkowski (Everton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Southampton have a free kick.
17' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) sends a long ball in, but Aaron Ramsdale comfortably gathers the ball.
17' A cross from Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
16' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
16' Andy Madley interrupts the game. One of the players from Southampton won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Everton have a free kick.
13' It seemed like Dwight McNeil (Everton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
13' Adam Lallana (Southampton) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Everton have a free kick.
12' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
11' Michael Keane (Everton) makes a strong challenge and Andy Madley blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Southampton.
10' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
9' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
6' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) is caught offside!
3' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Aaron Ramsdale.
3' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Everton win a free kick.
2' Adam Lallana (Southampton) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Everton.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Everton will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andy Madley.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
